lee (sre): creating runbook blurb: "If envoy-sidecar daemonset roll overlaps with active connections -> expect short 502/504 spikes; stagger rolls per AZ and drain connections gracefully"

harper (oncall): handing watch to lee for remainder of window, i'll be offline in 10m
